# BitPrecisionAwareScheduling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A scheduling technique that orders computation based on the bit-precision requirements of operations to optimize resource utilization in mixed-precision accelerators. Improves throughput and energy efficiency in topology-centric and neuromorphic systems where heterogeneous precision is common.
